name: Carrageenan
aliases: E407, E407a, carrageenan, processed eucheuma seaweed, Irish moss gelose, eucheuman, furcellaran, carragenano, carraghenane
what_is: A family of sulfated polysaccharides extracted from red seaweeds and used to gel, thicken or stabilise foods; E407a is processed Eucheuma seaweed.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E407 and E407a because the label does not reveal their molecular-weight profile. EFSA left its group ADI temporary while seeking better data on low-molecular-weight material and unresolved intestinal inflammatory effects.
can_1: Detect the presence of E407 or E407a and classify it under the texture layer.
can_2: Provide warning details about low molecular weight fractions or processing aids.
cannot_1: Verify the exact level of low molecular weight carrageenan contaminants below 50 kDa.
cannot_2: Detect trace levels of extraction solvent residues used in its isolation.
title: Carrageenan
description: A hydrocolloid extracted from red seaweeds.
